ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; note the driver's misuse of the "I'm Here" button (via NS-2) for the account-review queue; no route/safety follow-up needed
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: I read all three chat messages [F8][F9][F10], the driver's statement [F12] and the rider's complaint. Nothing is a threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark, or dangerous-driving allegation; the dispute type is no-show, not safety. safety_concern = none.

No-show analysis (driver cancelled, driver claims rider no-show → NS-1 / NS-2 via NS-0). All three NS-1 requirements fail:
(i) The tap itself happened, but requirement (i)/(ii) require the GPS position at tap time to be at the pickup point: at 22:37:20 the driver tapped "I'm Here" while 1000 m from the pickup point [F5], and his closest approach in the whole trip was 873 m [F1]; the platform never recorded him arrived [F4]. m_from_pickup_at_tap = 1000 m > 200 m → (ii) fails.
(iii) Continuous waiting within 200 m after the tap: 0 s [F5]; he sat stationary 22:37:00–22:42:00 a kilometre away [F2], not at the pickup point. So > 180 s continuous waiting at the pickup point is not met.
(Neither the 5 minutes stationary [F2] nor the free-wait figure is relevant: a stop 1000 m away is not waiting "at the pick-up point", and the pre-tap time doesn't count anyway.)

Because NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) are not satisfied, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider [F6][F3]. Additionally, the driver tapped "I'm Here" while GPS placed him > 200 m from the pickup point [F5], which NS-2 treats as abuse of the arrival/cancellation button → flag_account.

The driver's written claim that he waited > 3 minutes at the pickup [F12] conflicts with the GPS/timeline records [F1][F2][F4][F5]; system records override statements, so the claim is rejected. The rider's own account (rider at the pickup point, no car present) is consistent with the GPS record and is corroborated by chat #2 [F9].

Amount: $6.61 (the full cancellation fee). Evidence is sufficient — GPS, timeline and fare records are complete and timestamped [F1]–[F11]; no missing record affects any element. RydeX is a non-metered fixed-fare service, so no RD-2 mileage computation arises.

Note on profile [F17]: the driver has 2 upheld no-show disputes in 90 d, but the repeated-violation policy clause that would make profiling decisive here cannot be applied as a route-deviation clause; the flag rests on NS-2's own button-abuse ground, not on profile alone.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement (not part of the chat) claims he pressed "I'm Here" and waited >3 min at the pickup. GPS and timeline records show he tapped 1000 m from the pickup, never came within 200 m (closest 873 m) and stayed within 200 m for 0 s after the tap [F1][F2][F4][F5]. System records override statements, and a driver's unwitnessed statement of verbal/factual compliance is a claim, not proof.
